$schema-note: Quality ratchet (SUI-FEATURE-128, GL-CODE-002). Finding count per tool of the gate phases `hygiene` and `knip`; scripts/hygiene.ts turns the phase red when a measured count rises above its entry. A count may only fall; raising an entry is an owner decision in the register. Values come only from `npm run hygiene:inventory` on main and change only with `npx spec-sync measure set|remove`. Size lines are not counts: they live in size-limit-lines.json, and `size-limit.over-maximum` counts the entries above their maximum.
